headline: Executive order signed in 2020 directing federal action to improve health care and telehealth access in rural areas.
what_it_does: This executive order directs the federal government to take steps to improve health care in rural areas and expand access to telehealth, meaning care delivered by phone or video. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and deadlines it sets cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in rural areas
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to improve their access to health care services, including telehealth.
The order addresses access to care delivered remotely by phone or video.

who_it_affects.group: Rural hospitals and health care providers
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by federal actions taken to improve rural health care, though details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 3, 2020; specific deadlines for agency actions are not stated in the material provided.
